I've attached a small sample traffic export and a sketch of the pipeline. Would love a short demo to understand latency profiles and routing options (hosted vs dedicated). If helpful, cc'd is Priya (ops) who can share retention/PII constraints.

Thanks Ben — Fri 11:30 PDT works for us. Quick answers inline: 
1) Payload: ~600–900 bytes JSON (mostly product ids + context features), roughly 150–250 tokens.
2) Concurrent active users at peak: ~400–600 parallel sessions; concurrency across recommendation endpoints may be higher briefly.

I'll accept the slot via the Calendly link now. Priya will be on the call to cover retention requirements.
